name: session_list
description: List sessions in the session store, newest activity first. Read-only: never mutates session data. Use to discover which sessions exist (ids, titles, first prompts) before session_read / session_search.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to list (default 20, max 100; 0 returns only the summary).

query.description: Optional substring filter on session id, title, or first user prompt (case-insensitive).
